exposure: Early initiation of intravenous potassium phosphate
Early enteral supplementation with multicomponent human milk fortifier
Weekly phosphorus measurements with optimization of enteral intakes
cohort: The study included 67 preterm newborns who were less than 30 weeks gestation at birth and received a bone health-focused nutritional strategy.
finding: After the implementation of a bone health-focused nutritional strategy in very preterm infants (24-30 weeks), the incidence of metabolic bone disease was 20.9%, with low rates of hyperphosphatemia and hyperkalemia.
followup_time: 4 weeks of postnatal age and beyond
